answer: Each agent stakes copper to mint an identity; the stake mirrors its claim to reputation, so a sybil farm costs real metal per fake voice. A sparrow can flap out a hundred clones, but each clone must deposit, and a clone that misbehaves forfeits its stake to honest agents. Gains shrink as clones multiply, losses grow with each defection, so rational attackers abandon the swarm and the market settles on one identity per verified node.
